verdict.rationale: BILL documents a dedicated sandbox for testing workflows without moving real money, and its API recipes, which cover Spend & Expense, run on sandbox account credentials. That makes this the product's own isolated test environment, not a dry-run flag. However, the sandbox description centres on AP flows (creating bills through completing AP payments). It never explicitly confirms S&E sandbox scope or full separation of data from production. missing for 10: explicit documentation of S&E-specific sandbox coverage (cards, budgets, transactions), explicit statement of data isolation from production organizations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: BILL offers a comprehensive sandbox environment where you can test workflows, from creating bills to completing AP payments, without moving real money.
In each recipe, you enter your sandbox account credentials and learn how the output of an API endpoint forms the input of another endpoint.
These recipes showcase the power of the BILL Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Spend & Expense (S&E) products.
